description: Free, no payment, read-only. Lists Genesis402 endpoints with name, HTTP path, USD price, title and parameter schema, read from the rail's live /.well-known/x402 manifest (refreshed every 10 minutes). Use it to find an endpoint that has no dedicated genesis402_* tool, then pass its exact name and parameters to genesis402_call. Filter by keyword to keep the list short (e.g. "defi", "sec", "wiki"); with no filter it returns every endpoint, up to 400. Returns the rail origin, total endpoint count, number matched, the current payer mode (QUOTE_ONLY, HOSTED or LIVE with its cap) and the matching endpoints.

filter.description: Optional keyword to narrow the list, matched against endpoint name, title and tags, e.g. "defi", "sec", "price". Omit for all endpoints.

specialist.description: Optional specialist to list only its endpoints: prices, chain-reader, defi, web, geo-records, research, ai-tools or utilities.

name: genesis402_catalog

by_specialist.description: Endpoints per specialist across the whole catalog; "none" counts the routes with no specialist.

endpoints.description: Matching endpoints, at most 400, grouped by specialist (routes without one last).

name.description: Endpoint name to pass to genesis402_call.

price_usd.description: Price per call in USD, null if the manifest carries none.

specialist.description: The specialist that sells this endpoint; absent for a desk-sold or ungrouped route.

matched.description: Number of endpoints matching the filter.

origin.description: Rail origin the catalog was read from.

payer_mode.description: QUOTE_ONLY, HOSTED, or LIVE (cap $X) for a local self-paying server.

receipts_url.description: Public receipts feed, where a paid call's signed receipt can be looked up.

seller.description: Who is paid and who issues the receipt: the seller's ERC-8004 agent id, registry and receipts feed.

agent_id.description: ERC-8004 agent id of the seller on Base. 95721 is the Genesis402 rail; a route sold by a desk agent names that agent.

collector.description: ERC-8004 id of the collecting agent whose wallet receives the payment (95721). Present with specialist.

pay_to.description: The Base address this route is paid to, as quoted in the 402.

receipts.description: Public feed of signed receipts for paid calls.

registry.description: CAIP-10 style registry reference, eip155:8453:<IdentityRegistry address>.

registry_address.description: ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry contract address on Base.

source.description: rail: named by the rail in its 402 or manifest. package: this package's default, used when the rail names none.

specialist.description: Present when the route is sold by one of the rail's eight specialists (prices, chain-reader, defi, web, geo-records, research, ai-tools, utilities).

total_endpoints.description: Number of endpoints in the live manifest.

title: List endpoints and prices (free)
